lines.en: label mayaspring1:
scene nightsky
There was a time long ago where I practically lived at the dorms.
lines.zh: 很久以前，有那么一阵子我几乎就住在宿舍里。

lines.en: Where every night there was someone to help me take my mind off something.
lines.zh: 那时候每一夜都有人帮我把心思从某件事上挪开。

lines.en: Just, when this all began, there wasn’t much to take my mind off in the first place. So, more often than not, I found myself searching for anything of...interest.
lines.zh: 只是，在这一切刚开始的时候，本来也没什么需要我挪开心思的事。所以大多数时候，我发现自己在找任何……有趣的东西。

lines.en: Often, that interest was sexual in nature. And I guess that much hasn’t entirely changed.
lines.zh: 那种兴趣往往是性方面的。我想这一点到现在也没怎么变。

lines.en: But there was something else back then. Curiosity, I guess you could call it.
lines.zh: 但那时候还有别的东西。好奇心吧，也许可以这么叫。

lines.en: And most of that bled from a girl so consistently dismissive and weird that I found myself drawn to her almost immediately.
lines.zh: 而那大部分都源自一个女孩——她一贯地冷淡又古怪，以至于我几乎立刻就被吸引了过去。

lines.en: But perhaps that’s just the way it’s always been.
lines.zh: 但也许一直就是这样。

lines.en: No, not “perhaps.” That is the way it’s always been. Since before I was me. Since before I wasn’t.
lines.zh: 不，不是“也许”。一直就是这样。早在我还是我之前。早在我还不是我之前。

lines.en: She was always the constant.
lines.zh: 她一直是那个恒量。

lines.en: She was always the one.
lines.zh: 她一直是那一个人。

lines.en: scene black
Until she wasn’t.
lines.zh: 直到她不再是。

scene mayaboxwaitwhat1
NOW SHE’S FOLDED UP IN A BLANKET OF FLESH — A FACADE TO FUCK AND NOTHING MORE. THE GUM STUCK TO THE BOTTOM OF THIS ETERNAL SHOE.
lines.zh: 现在她被裹进了一层血肉的毯子里——一具用来操的门面，仅此而已。粘在这只永恒之鞋鞋底的口香糖。

lines.en: I WANT TO TEAR HER OPEN AND PULL THE OLD ONE OUT. WHO DOES SHE THINK SHE IS MASQUERADING IN CLOTHES THAT DON’T FIT? TOUCHING HER THINGS?
lines.zh: 我想把她撕开，把原来那个拖出来。她算什么东西，穿着不合身的衣服招摇过市？还碰她的东西？

lines.en: I HOPE THERE’S A WISH INSIDE OF THAT BOX FOR SHE WILL NEED ONE TO BREATHE LIFE BACK INTO HER BODY WHEN I AM FINISHED WITH-
lines.zh: 我希望那只盒子里装着一个愿望，因为等我对她下手完，她会需要一个愿望，才能把生命重新吹回她的身体里——

lines.en: : DON’T KILL ME AGAIN! PLEASE!
lines.zh: : 别再杀我了！求你了！

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat2
: Hi?
: ...Maya?
lines.zh: : ……Maya？

lines.en: : Which Maya?
lines.zh: : 哪个 Maya？

lines.en: : Old Maya? Or...new Maya?
lines.zh: : 旧 Maya？还是……新 Maya？

lines.en: : Maya Maya. The only Maya there is.
lines.zh: : Maya 就是 Maya。唯一的那个 Maya。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat3
: But I guess I’m “new” Maya based on the way you have separated us into different tiers of Mayability now despite us being the same exact entity on a conceptual level.
lines.zh: : 不过按你现在的分法，把我们按"Maya 度"分成不同等级，那我大概算是"新"Maya 吧，尽管我们在概念层面上是同一个存在。

lines.en: Of course it was too good to be true. Of course the only “constant” now is that feeling there should be something by my side when there isn’t.
lines.zh: 当然了，好得不像真的。当然了，现在唯一的"恒量"就是那种——本该有东西在我身边，却没有的感觉。

lines.en: But why?
lines.zh: 可是为什么？

lines.en: Why is she holding that?
lines.zh: 为什么她抱着那个东西？

lines.en: : What...are you doing?
lines.zh: : 你……在干什么？

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat4
: What are you doing? You’ve been standing there useless for five minutes now while a small girl is being crushed by the weight of this box.
lines.zh: : 你在干什么？你都站在那儿当废物站了五分钟了，一个小女孩正被这个盒子压得喘不过气。

lines.en: : Isn’t this the part where you offer to help me carry it?
lines.zh: : 这难道不是你该主动提出帮我搬的时候吗？

lines.en: : Why...are you carrying it?
lines.zh: : 为什么……你在搬这个？

lines.en: : Why are you getting so emotional over a box? It’s just a box.
lines.zh: : 你为什么对一个盒子这么上心？它就是个盒子而已。

lines.en: : Because this has happened before. This is something she would make me do.
lines.zh: : 因为这种事以前发生过。这是她会让我做的事。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat5
: Millions and billions and trillions of years or whatever and still lazy. I’m so proud of me.
lines.zh: : 几百万、几十亿、几万亿年还是什么的，还是这么懒。我真为自己骄傲。

lines.en: : Maya...what’s in that? What are you...transporting?
lines.zh: : Maya……那里面是什么？你在……运什么？

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat4
: Well, what did your me make you transport? Maybe it’s the same thing.
lines.zh: : 那你的那个我让你运过什么？也许是同样的东西。

lines.en: : I don’t know. She never let me open the box.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。她从来不让我打开盒子。

lines.en: : Do you...want to open the box?
lines.zh: : 你……想打开盒子吗？

lines.en: : Can I?...
lines.zh: : 我可以吗？……

lines.en: : Sure. Go for it.
lines.zh: : 当然。尽管试。

lines.en: I reach forward and-
lines.zh: 我伸手向前，然后——

lines.en: menu:
Don’t open the box
lines.zh: 别打开盒子

lines.en: And I still...can’t.
lines.zh: 而我依然……做不到。

lines.en: : What’s the matter?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？

lines.en: : I...can’t do it.
lines.zh: : 我……做不到。

lines.en: : I just...can’t bring myself to open it.
lines.zh: : 我就是……下不了手打开它。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat6
: I fucking knew it! This thing is cursed!
lines.zh: : 我他妈就知道！这玩意儿被诅咒了！

lines.en: : I...what? I don’t understand. You-
lines.zh: : 我……什么？我不明白。你——

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat7
: I can’t open it either! I have no idea what’s inside!
lines.zh: : 我也打不开！我根本不知道里面是什么！

lines.en: : Then why are you-
lines.zh: : 那你为什么——

lines.en: : Because of fucking Ami!
lines.zh: : 因为fucking Ami！

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat8
: She keeps leaving these fucking boxes in there and refuses to move them herself.
lines.zh: : 她不停把那些该死的盒子留在里面，自己却死也不肯搬。

lines.en: : So I’ve just been taking them every time she shows up and throwing them in the trash.
lines.zh: : 所以每次她一出现，我就把它们拿走，扔进垃圾桶。

lines.en: : The...trash?! No! Those aren’t supposed to go in there! They need to go to the school!
lines.zh: : 垃圾……桶？！不行！那些不该扔那儿！它们得送到学校去！

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat9
: The school? Why?
lines.zh: : 学校？为什么？

lines.en: : That’s just...
lines.zh: : 那只是……

lines.en: : That’s where we always took them in the past. I don’t...really know why.
lines.zh: : 那是我们以前一直送过去的地方。我……其实也不知道为什么。

lines.en: : So you...routinely fell into line and carried these things all the way to the school just because “old” me told you? No questions asked?
lines.zh: : 所以你……就乖乖听话，一路把这些东西扛到学校去，只因为"旧"的我这么说了？一句也不问？

lines.en: : There were questions asked. Just...seldom answered.
lines.zh: : 问过。只是……很少得到回答。

lines.en: : Damn. You are whipped.
lines.zh: : 天哪。你被吃得死死的。

lines.en: : Were whipped. I’m a free man now. Sad, yes. But free.
lines.zh: : 曾经被吃得死死的。我现在是自由身了。可悲，没错。但自由。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat10
: For now. But each hint you give me about your “ideal” version of me just brings me one step closer to emulating her.
lines.zh: : 暂时是。可你每给我一点关于你"理想版本"的我的提示，就让我离模仿她更近一步。

lines.en: : Which means that I’ll be cracking the whip before you even know it, Sensei. Now please, make yourself useful and take this off of my hands.
lines.zh: : 也就是说，在你反应过来之前，我就会开始挥鞭子了，Sensei。所以现在，麻烦你有点用，把这个从我手上接过去。

lines.en: : I’m waiting.
lines.zh: : 我在等。

lines.en: scene black
: Hah...fine. But we’re taking it to the school.
lines.zh: : 哈……好吧。但我们得把它送去学校。

lines.en: : Fine by me. You’re the one doing all of the heavy lifting. Literally. And I’m still dressed for the part.
lines.zh: : 我没意见。反正出力气的字面意义上是你。而且我这身打扮也挺应景的。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat11
: Why are you still wearing your uniform anyway?
lines.zh: : 话说你怎么还穿着制服？

lines.en: : I wanted to be ready in case we randomly crossed paths. I didn’t want to risk dressing like an adult and having you suddenly not like me anymore.
lines.zh: : 我想万一我们偶然撞见，我得随时准备好。我不想冒险穿得像个成年人，结果你突然就不喜欢我了。

lines.en: : I don’t think adults wear bells around their neck.
lines.zh: : 我觉得成年人不会在脖子上挂铃铛。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat12
: They do when their pervert boyfriends buy them as gifts. Did I ever say thank you for that, by the way?
lines.zh: : 如果铃铛是她们的变态男朋友买来送的，那就会。话说回来，我有为那个道过谢吗？

lines.en: : I wouldn’t remember even if you had.
lines.zh: : 就算你谢过我也不记得了。

lines.en: : Let’s just say I did then. And let’s also say that I still have a few other things you bought me for the same creepy purposes.
lines.zh: : 那就当我谢过吧。另外，你为了同样猥琐的目的买给我的其他几样东西，我也还留着。

lines.en: : You have what now?
lines.zh: : 你还有什么？

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat13
: Oooooh? Did your Maya keep her sexy cosplay closet a secret? But you spent so much money on it.
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦？难道你的 Maya 把她的性感角色扮演衣柜藏起来了？可你在上面花了那么多钱呢。

lines.en: : You...you have a secret sexy cosplay closet?
lines.zh: : 你……你有个秘密的性感角色扮演衣柜？

lines.en: : You’re more than welcome to raid it with me once you accept me for who I am and stop trying to turn me into your comfortably numb dream-girl thing.
lines.zh: : 等你接受我本来的样子、不再试图把我变成你那个舒适麻木的梦幻女孩，我很欢迎你跟我一起去翻。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat14
: Fucking Maya...of course she’d hide that from me. There’d be no holding me back at all if I ever found out.
lines.zh: : Fucking Maya……她当然会瞒着我。要是我早发现了，就再也没什么能拦得住我了。

lines.en: : Sounds like you and I would have been reacquainted much sooner if you did. So I guess I’ll go ahead and be mad at her too.
lines.zh: : 听上去，你要是真发现了，我们早就重修旧好了。那我也就一起生她的气好了。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat15
: Can I...ask you something?
lines.zh: : 我能……问你一件事吗？

lines.en: : I already told you. I don’t know what’s in the box.
lines.zh: : 我说过了。我不知道盒子里是什么。

lines.en: : Not that. Just...did giving up on me ever cross your mind this past year? Did you not lose hope in me at any point?
lines.zh: : 不是那个。只是……过去这一年里，你有没有想过要放弃我？有没有在哪个瞬间对我失去过希望？

lines.en: : Of course not. Losing hope would imply that I ever had any hope in you to begin with. And that’s just dumb.
lines.zh: : 当然没有。失去希望的前提是我一开始对你抱有希望。那也太蠢了。

lines.en: : Seriously, though...did you ever think about just...trying to find someone else?
lines.zh: : 说真的……你有没有想过……去找别人？

lines.en: : Romantically? No. I want you, so I am going to have you because I am cute and that entitles me to getting whatever it is I want.
lines.zh: : 恋爱意义上的？没有。我想要你，所以我要得到你，因为我很可爱，而这就让我有权得到我想要的任何东西。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat16
: I did have a sex dream about Otoha once, though. So you can go ahead and call that some sort of forbidden desire if that turns you on or something.
lines.zh: : 不过我有一次做了个关于 Otoha 的春梦。要是那样能让你兴奋还是什么的，你尽管把这当成某种禁忌的欲望好了。

lines.en: : It’s fine. I, too, have had sex dreams about Otoha.
lines.zh: : 没关系。我也做过关于 Otoha 的春梦。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat17
: You bastard. I am right here. Have you no consideration whatsoever for my feelings?
lines.zh: : 你这个混蛋。我就在这儿。你就一点都不顾及我的感受吗？

lines.en: : I can’t tell if you’re being serious or not.
lines.zh: : 我分不清你是认真的还是在开玩笑。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat18
: There’s a little bit of truth in every single lie, you know?  I won’t let myself get beat up over it, though.
lines.zh: : 每个谎言里都有一点点真话，你知道吗？不过我不会为这个让自己挨揍。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat19
: I know I’ve got my work cut out for me if I’m going to find myself on the same level as all of the girls you’re currently sleeping with who haven’t disappeared at some point.
lines.zh: : 我知道，要爬到和那些你现在正在睡、又从没在某个时点消失过的女孩同一水平线上，我还有得忙。

lines.en: : But I’ll get there. I’ll get there and you’ll see why you chose me as “the one” long before you even met any of those girls.
lines.zh: : 但我会的。我会做到，然后你就会明白，早在遇见她们任何一个之前，你为什么选了我当"那一个人"。

lines.en: : Then things will be good again. And we can go back to normal. Or change what’s normal if that’s really what you want.
lines.zh: : 然后一切就会重新好起来。我们就能回到正轨。或者，如果你真想的话，把"正轨"换一个样子。

lines.en: : It’s like falling in love all over. I should feel lucky I get to experience that again.
lines.zh: : 就像重新坠入爱河。我应该觉得庆幸，还能再体验一次。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat20
: But instead, I’m just sad.
lines.zh: : 可我有的只是难过。

lines.en: : I miss you, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我想你，Sensei。

lines.en: : Maya-
lines.zh: : Maya——

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat21
: Come on! Let’s get that box to school for whatever reason we’re supposed to take it there!
lines.zh: : 走吧！不管我们为什么要把那盒子送去学校，赶紧送过去！

lines.en: scene black
: Hah...yeah.
: I’m right behind you.
lines.zh: : 我就跟在你后面。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat22
: Wow. This place is actually kind of creepy at night.
lines.zh: : 哇。这地方晚上还真有点瘆人。

lines.en: : You should see it when it’s all red and crawling with weird, paranormal entities.
lines.zh: : 你该看看它整个变成红色、爬满奇怪的灵异实体的时候。

lines.en: : Do I have to? That sounds like it sucks.
lines.zh: : 非看不可吗？听起来糟透了。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t say you have to. Just know that if you do, it’s actually a good thing because it means you can start learning more about how the world works.
lines.zh: : 我不会说非看不可。只是你要真看到了，其实那是好事，因为那意味着你可以开始多了解这个世界是怎么运转的。

lines.en: : Or...doesn’t work. It’s complicated.
lines.zh: : 或者……是怎么不运转的。挺复杂的。

lines.en: : More...time stuff...right? Things that your me was interested in?
lines.zh: : 又是……时间那一类的事……对吧？你的那个我感兴趣的东西？

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat23
: I’m not really sure how much of it was interest and...how much was just a result of her being forced to endure it for so long.
lines.zh: : 我不太确定其中有多少是兴趣，又有多少只是她被迫忍耐了太久的结果。

lines.en: : Well, for what it’s worth, I am interested in that stuff. Sci-fi. Quantum physics. But it’s all more fiction-focused than anything involving actual science.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，我对那些东西是感兴趣的。科幻。量子物理。只是比起真正的科学，我更偏向虚构那一边。

lines.en: : But I blame you for that. You and Billy Pilgrim.
lines.zh: : 但这都得怪你。你，还有 Billy Pilgrim。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat24
: Me?
: Mhm. You and the high school curriculum you forced onto a child because you were so starved for an actual intellectual conversation after your sex-mom died.
lines.zh: : 嗯。还有你硬塞给一个小孩子的那套高中课程，因为你的性妈妈死后，你饿得要命，就想找人好好聊点有智识的东西。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat25
: Well, that sentence hit me like a truck.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这句话像卡车一样撞了我一下。

lines.en: : There’s another joke to be made here, but I think that one might be pushing it a bit.
lines.zh: : 这里还能再开一个玩笑，不过我觉得那个可能有点过了。

lines.en: : I’d appreciate it if you wouldn’t call her a “sex-mom” in the future. She was...a lot more than that, Maya.
lines.zh: : 希望你以后别再叫她"性妈妈"了。她……远远不止是那样，Maya。

lines.en: : Right. Just like how you are more to me than what you tell yourself you are.
lines.zh: : 说得对。就像你对我来说，也远远不止是你告诉自己的那个样子。

lines.en: : So please don’t die, for I have seen what I would turn into and it is not pretty. If nothing else, try living for that.
lines.zh: : 所以请别死。因为我已经见过我会变成什么样子，那可不好看。别的不说，就算为了这个，也试着活下去吧。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat26
: I’m gonna go stash this in the room beside you. I’m pretty sure...that was the one we always put them in.
lines.zh: : 我去把它藏到你旁边那间教室里。我挺确定……以前我们一直放在那一间。

lines.en: : Okay...I’ll be here.
lines.zh: : 好……我在这儿等你。

lines.en: scene black
I slide open the door to an empty classroom and drop the box off in the corner, trying (and failing) once more to open it.
lines.zh: 我拉开一间空教室的门，把盒子搁在角落，再一次试着（并且失败地）打开它。

lines.en: I want to stay here.
lines.zh: 我想留在这儿。

lines.en: Not just so I don’t have to go back out into the hall and face the fact that even this version of her — who smiles and speaks to me — is one I want to enrapture...
lines.zh: 不只是为了不必走回走廊、去面对这样一个事实——即便是这个版本的她，这个会笑、会跟我说话的她，也是我想要占有的……

lines.en: But to figure out what this is. And how Ami is somehow involved now.
lines.zh: 更是为了弄清楚这是什么。以及 Ami 怎么会也卷进来了。

lines.en: Why would she ask Maya to take this here? Why can’t Maya open it either?
lines.zh: 她为什么要让 Maya 把这个带到这里？为什么 Maya 也打不开？

lines.en: Was that...always how it worked?
lines.zh: 难道……一直都是这样的吗？

lines.en: Was that just something else she hid from me?
lines.zh: 难道那也是她瞒着我的另一件事？

lines.en: If I stay here, maybe I can see what happens.
lines.zh: 如果我留在这儿，也许我能看见接下来会发生什么。

lines.en: Maybe I can see who comes to take this to wherever it’s meant to be- because it most assuredly isn’t the first. And it most assuredly won’t be the last.
lines.zh: 也许我能看见谁来把它带去它该去的地方——因为它绝对不是第一个，也绝对不会是最后一个。

lines.en: If I never leave, though...
lines.zh: 可要是我永远不离开……

lines.en: I’ll never see that smile again.
lines.zh: 我就再也见不到那个笑容了。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat27
And I’ll also never figure out what’s inside of the apparent sex closet — which is now, unfortunately, a top priority for me.
lines.zh: 而且我也永远搞不清那个所谓的性爱衣柜里有什么——这很不幸，现在已经成了我的头等大事。

lines.en: Right after I figure out why Maya dragged me back into my old classroom.
lines.zh: 就排在搞清楚 Maya 为什么把我拖回我以前那间教室之后。

lines.en: : Been a while, hasn’t it?
lines.zh: : 好久没回来了吧？

lines.en: : And for good reason. I was never fit to be a high school teacher.
lines.zh: : 而且不无道理。我从来就不适合当高中老师。

lines.en: : You sure weren’t, Sensei. And anyone who’d pay you to hang out with teenage girls clearly isn’t fit to serve this community either.
lines.zh: : 你确实不适合，Sensei。再说，任何花钱雇你去陪少女厮混的人，显然也不配为这个社区服务。

lines.en: : That was the part where most other people try to say something uplifting about how my methods are “unusual” but how I’ve wound up helping in the long run.
lines.zh: : 这种时候，大多数人都会试图说点激励的话，比如我的方法"不同寻常"，但从长远看我还是帮上了忙之类的。

lines.en: : Then I guess I don’t need to say anything because I’m living proof of that.
lines.zh: : 那我看我就什么也不用说了，因为我就是活生生的证据。

lines.en: : Everything I am is because of you. And you have the rare opportunity right now to continue cultivating me. To make me something even bigger.
lines.zh: : 我之所以是我，全都是因为你。而现在你有一个难得的机会，可以继续栽培我。把我塑造成更了不起的东西。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat28
: So come — over here. To my desk.
lines.zh: : 所以过来吧——到这边来。到我的课桌前。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat29
: Teach me more about who I’ll be next. About what you want the result of the “Maya Raising Project” to be.
lines.zh: : 再多教教我，我接下来会成为谁。你想要"Maya 养成计划"的最终成果是什么样的。

lines.en: : I want you to be whatever makes you happy.
lines.zh: : 我想让你成为任何让你开心的样子。

lines.en: : Hahah. Cute. But really — what do you really want?
lines.zh: : 哈哈。真可爱。不过说真的——你到底想要什么？

lines.en: : An actor? Want me to perfectly mimic your last true love? Recite her lines like they’re my own? Even if they are my own. Which they are. Because again, same person.
lines.zh: : 演员？要我完美复刻你上一位真爱？把她的台词像自己的一样念出来？反正它们本来就是我的。因为再说一遍，同一个人。

lines.en: : Or maybe someone even smarter than you? Someone like her. The first girl you lost.
lines.zh: : 或者，也许是个比你更聪明的人？像她那样的人。你失去的第一个女孩。

lines.en: : Just, whatever you do, don’t ask me to be an idol because I fucking hate Niki and I fucking hate her annoying bitch of a sister.
lines.zh: : 只是，不管你要我做什么，别叫我当偶像，因为我他妈的讨厌 Niki，也他妈的讨厌她那个烦人的婊子妹妹。

lines.en: : I don’t know. I kind of want to see idol Maya now. Is there something like that in the sex closet?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我现在倒有点想看偶像版 Maya 了。性爱衣柜里有那种东西吗？

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat30
: There sure is. It just brings back bad memories.
lines.zh: : 当然有。只是会勾起不好的回忆。

lines.en: : Was I too rough on you while you were wearing it?
lines.zh: : 是你穿着它的时候对我太粗暴了吗？

lines.en: : Worse. You started crying.
lines.zh: : 更糟。你哭了。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Well, I’ve gotten more used to banging idols since then, so maybe that won’t happen anymore?
lines.zh: : 嗯，从那以后我干偶像干得比较习惯了，所以也许不会再那样了？

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat31
: Again. I am right here. And still very much upset over the fact that your childhood friend is now sleeping in the same bed as you, thank you very much.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍。我就在这儿。而且我现在还很在意你那位青梅竹马如今睡在同一张床上这件事，非常感谢。

lines.en: : So is it her you hate more? Or Noriko?
lines.zh: : 那你更恨的是她？还是 Noriko？

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat32
: How is that relevant?! Aren’t you supposed to be teaching me about “old” Maya?!
lines.zh: : 这有什么关系？！你不是应该给我讲讲"旧"Maya 吗？！

lines.en: : Old Maya hated both of them too and it was always sort of a touchy subject.
lines.zh: : 旧 Maya 也恨她们两个，而且这一直是个有点敏感的话题。

lines.en: : It’s a touchy subject now too! So why do I have to be the one to do it?!
lines.zh: : 现在也是敏感话题！那为什么非得由我来开口？！

lines.en: : Because I can no longer be gaslit into thinking that information may cause both the universe and me to explode.
lines.zh: : 因为我再也不会被忽悠着相信"这些信息可能会让宇宙和我一起爆炸"了。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat33
: Fine. You caught me. It is I — Maya prime. I never disappeared at all. I just faked it for attention. Guess we have to have sex now. Oh well.
lines.zh: : 行吧。你抓到我了。就是我——Maya 本尊。我根本没消失过。我只是为了博关注装的。看来现在我们得做爱了。唉，没办法。

lines.en: : Wake me up when it’s over. I’ll be thinking about time and stuff.
lines.zh: : 完事儿了叫我。我要去想时间和那些东西了。

lines.en: : Close, but you’re not there yet.
lines.zh: : 很接近了，但还没到。

lines.en: : Fuck.
: You really won’t talk about it?
lines.zh: : 你真的不肯谈这个？

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat34
: Sensei — I’m bad at talking. I don’t know how else to get that through to you. Like, fuck- all this banter alone is enough to make my head hurt.
lines.zh: : Sensei——我不擅长说话。我不知道还能怎么让你明白。操，光是这些斗嘴就够让我头疼了。

lines.en: : Then why-
lines.zh: : 那为什么——

lines.en: : I said it earlier. Because I miss you.
lines.zh: : 我刚才说过了。因为我想你。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat35
: When I sit down and try to remember literally anything about any part of my life — you’re there. You have always been there.
lines.zh: : 每当我坐下来，努力回想我人生里任何一部分的任何一件事——你都在那儿。你一直都在那儿。

lines.en: : So going this long without you and having to learn how to function as an actual independent person has been fucking bullshit.
lines.zh: : 所以这么长时间没有你，还得学着当一个真正独立的人，真是他妈的一坨狗屎。

lines.en: : Which I’m sure you’ll give me shit about since you always talked about how important that was during tutoring, but whatever. I’ve never really wanted to be my own thing since meeting you in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我猜你肯定会拿这个挤兑我，毕竟你辅导我的时候总说那有多重要，但随便吧。自从遇见你，我就从来没真想成为自己的什么。

lines.en: : So yeah, I’ll talk to you. I’ll talk your ear off because I’m just excited to be near you again. I’m excited you’ll listen.
lines.zh: : 所以没错，我会跟你说话。我会说到你耳朵起茧，因为我就是很高兴又能待在你身边。我很高兴你愿意听。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat36
: But that doesn’t mean it’s easy...even if it sounds like it is. Even if it looks like it is. Because things aren’t always exactly as they seem.
lines.zh: : 但这不代表那很容易……哪怕听起来容易。哪怕看起来容易。因为事情并不总是看起来那样。

lines.en: : You should know that much...right?
lines.zh: : 这一点你应该很清楚……对吧？

lines.en: : Yeah...I know that much.
lines.zh: : 嗯……这一点我很清楚。

lines.en: : So can we...maybe wait on the whole Nakayama discussion? Until after I’ve gotten less sour about how she’s your number one now and I’m just...there.
lines.zh: : 那我们能不能……先别聊 Nakayama 的事？等我不再那么酸溜溜地想着她现在是你的第一位、而我只是在……那儿。

lines.en: : I never said she was my number one, Maya.
lines.zh: : 我从来没说过她是你的第一位，Maya。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat37
: She fucking sleeps in your bed, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 她他妈的睡在你的床上，Sensei……

lines.en: : She’s the first person to see you every single day. I’m lucky if I even do.
lines.zh: : 她是每天第一个见到你的人。我能见着你就算走运了。

lines.en: : Then I’ll see you more. Starting right now.
lines.zh: : 那我就多见你。从现在开始。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat38
: You...
: You will?
lines.zh: : 真的？

lines.en: : I will.
lines.zh: : 真的。

lines.en: : You’re not...just saying that to shut me up?
lines.zh: : 你不是……只是为了让我闭嘴才这么说的？

lines.en: : No...I’m not.
lines.zh: : 不是……我不是。

lines.en: : I’m ready to start...moving on. Or trying to. I can’t stay hung up on the memories of you when...
lines.zh: : 我已经准备好开始……往前走了。或者说试着往前走。我不能一直吊在对你的回忆里，当……

lines.en: : When...what?
lines.zh: : 当……什么？

lines.en: : When there’s a chance they might come back. That they’re...still in there somewhere. Like mine were.
lines.zh: : 当它们还有可能回来的时候。它们……还在某个地方。就像我那些回忆一样。

lines.en: : Just...mine were of...this same timeline. And yours would be of...probably millions.
lines.zh: : 只是……我那些是关于……同一条时间线的。而你的那些大概是关于……几百万条的。

lines.en: : That’s not the answer you wanted to hear, is it?
lines.zh: : 这不是你想听的答案，对吧？

lines.en: : I’d have liked something more normal there, I think. Now I just have to worry about what would happen to me if I suddenly had millions of years worth of memories.
lines.zh: : 我想我更希望听到正常一点的答案。现在我只得担心，如果我突然拥有了几百万年的记忆，我会变成什么样。

lines.en: : Memories without you. Memories of looking for you. When I just told you minutes ago that you’re there for all of mine.
lines.zh: : 没有你的记忆。寻找你的记忆。而我几分钟前才刚跟你说，我所有的记忆里都有你。

lines.en: : You want me to lose that?...
lines.zh: : 你希望我失去那些吗？……

lines.en: : I...well...
: Can you just tell me you love me instead?
lines.zh: : 你能不能干脆说你爱我？

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat39
: Or...something close at least.
lines.zh: : 或者……至少说点接近的。

lines.en: : Natsume Sōseki.
lines.zh: : Natsume Sōseki。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat40
: ...I’m sorry?
: You know that one line, right? The one people are always using to say a thing without saying a thing.
lines.zh: : 你知道那句台词吧？人们总是借它来说一件事，却又没真的说出口的那句。

lines.en: : I do...
lines.zh: : 我知道……

lines.en: : You’re not...going to say that thing, though?
lines.zh: : 你不会……是要说那句话吧？

lines.en: : Nope. Everybody says that thing now. So I’m just going to say the author’s name and you’re going to have to deal with it.
lines.zh: : 不。现在人人都说那句话了。所以我就只说作者的名字，你自己看着办吧。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat41
: Heh...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……

lines.en: : I’ll take it...
lines.zh: : 我收下了……

lines.en: : I hope you know I’m...gonna hold you to that whole “seeing me more” thing too. Like...don’t be surprised if I’m just...there when you wake up one day.
lines.zh: : 我希望你知道，那个"多见我"的事我也会跟你算账的。比如……哪天你醒来发现我就在那儿，别太惊讶。

lines.en: : Next to Niki?
lines.zh: : 在 Niki 旁边？

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat42
: Yeah. I can show her how it’s done. Then she’ll feel so bad about her own abilities that she’ll be forced to move out and I can move in instead.
lines.zh: : 对啊。我可以让她见识见识什么叫专业。然后她会对自己的能力惭愧到被迫搬走，我就可以搬进来了。

lines.en: : Yeah. I’m sure Ami would love that.
lines.zh: : 是啊。Ami 肯定喜欢。

lines.en: : Fuck Ami.
lines.zh: : 去他妈的 Ami。

lines.en: : I’m sure Ami would love that too.
lines.zh: : 我肯定 Ami 也会喜欢这句的。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat43
: Heheh...probably too much.
lines.zh: : 呵呵……大概喜欢得过头了。

lines.en: We stand there...just staring at each other for a while. Wanting more, but taking nothing.
lines.zh: 我们站在那儿……就这么盯着对方看了好一会儿。想要更多，却什么也不拿。

lines.en: It feels kind of strange — the way we’re watched by the moon. And how it dissuades me from grabbing her wrist and pulling her back to my home right now.
lines.zh: 感觉有点奇怪——月亮就这么看着我们。而它劝住了我，没有现在就抓住她的手腕、把她拽回我家。

lines.en: I think...
lines.zh: 我想……

lines.en: I think there’s somewhere else I want to take her instead, though.
lines.zh: 我想，我更想带她去的是别的地方。

lines.en: : Maya.
lines.zh: : Maya。

lines.en: : Sensei.
lines.zh: : Sensei。

lines.en: : Are you hungry?
lines.zh: : 你饿了吗？

lines.en: scene black
: Always.
lines.zh: : 一直都饿。

$ maya_love += 1
jump mayaspring2
